    Accessibility & App Tracking Permissions

    Enables automated active window telemetry and lockout shield

    Why is this permission required?

    Operating systems isolate applications for privacy. To accurately track how many minutes you spend inside specific applications (like YouTube, Instagram, Games, or Browsers) and block them when your limit is reached, Arc Tracker requests local on-device Accessibility & Usage Access.

    ✓ 100% Offline & Private • Zero cloud telemetry • Data never leaves your device

    Device Instructions:

    Android Phones / Tablets

    Enable Accessibility Service & Usage Access in Settings so Arc Tracker can monitor other apps.

    Windows & Laptops

    Permit Background Window Monitoring & Notifications so Arc Tracker can enforce boundaries.

    Launch When Device Turns On

    Start Arc Tracker as soon as your computer or phone turns on. Keep your dopamine shield and habits active 24/7 without having to remember to open the app.

    Windows 10 / 11 (Automatic 1-Click) RECOMMENDED

    Download the 1-Click Windows Startup installer script. It automatically registers Arc Tracker into your personal Windows Startup folder (shell:startup).

    Android Phone & Tablet
    1. Open device Settings ➔ Apps ➔ Arc Tracker.
    2. Tap Battery ➔ Unrestricted / Allow background activity.
    3. Enable Auto-start / Launch on reboot (on Xiaomi, OnePlus, Samsung & Realme devices).
    4. In Recent Apps overview, tap the Lock 🔒 icon on Arc Tracker to keep it pinned in memory.
    Apple macOS

    Open System Settings ➔ General ➔ Login Items, click the + button under "Open at Login", and select Arc Tracker.

    Auto-Start Setting Preference Record auto-start status in your operative profile
